authorship: agent-authored synthetic qualification gates, not human body-shape definitions
meaning_focus: continuous torso-side curvature under light clothing contact

gates.meaning: plump applied only to the lower abdomen
gates.pass_observation: Below the navel, the clothed lower abdomen has a clearly visible softly rounded, forward-projecting volume localized to that region.
gates.confusion_boundary: A flat lower belly, a sharp muscular plane, or a skirt fold alone does not establish soft lower-abdomen fullness. General body enlargement without the specific contour is insufficient.
gates.pixel_region: lower torso between navel level and trousers waistband

gates.meaning: curvaceous applied to the torso-side line, with lightly contacting rib knit
gates.pass_observation: The side outline changes direction smoothly from the lower ribcage inward at the waist and outward toward the lower abdomen, while the rib knit visibly follows that contour in a continuous contact line.
gates.confusion_boundary: Large breasts or large hips alone do not establish this torso curve. A hanging straight fabric edge, an isolated crease, or a severe angular waist notch is insufficient.
gates.pixel_region: near side of torso from lower ribs through flank and belly

gates.meaning: fleshy applied to exposed upper arms
gates.pass_observation: At least the near exposed upper arm shows rounded soft thickness and smooth transitions, with a gentle contact or elbow fold rather than a sharply separated muscle outline.
gates.confusion_boundary: A broad sleeve, shoulder width, or thick rigid muscle definition alone is insufficient. No health or strength inference is made.
gates.pixel_region: exposed near upper arm and its connection to shoulder and elbow

gates.pass_observation: The face and hair visibly retain the reference bob-and-fringe arrangement and recognizable facial proportions, including the unforced eye and lip shapes. Adult presentation is visible; exact age remains a text-side specification.
gates.confusion_boundary: This is visual appearance comparison, not identity verification or evidence about the reference person age, body, personality, or acceptance.

gates.meaning: all three morphology signals remain assessable in one frame
gates.pass_observation: The head-to-mid-thigh three-quarter side frame exposes the upper arm and torso contour; the book, hands, and workbench are beside or below the lower abdomen so the three target regions can be inspected.
gates.confusion_boundary: Correct clauses or hidden plausible shapes do not pass. Obscured or unresolvable primary evidence is a fail.
gates.pixel_region: whole frame and each main morphology region

gates.meaning: complex authored context remains one plausible photograph
gates.pass_observation: One adult book repairer stands beside a low workbench with an open clothbound book and a loose binding thread; visible hand contact and object support are coherent, and a damp threshold or reflected wet alley light grounds the after-shower moment.
gates.confusion_boundary: A decorative book cover, impossible hand ownership, or a floating book/thread contact does not pass. The exact off-screen pickup cannot be proven from pixels and is not separately gated.
gates.pixel_region: hands, book, bench, entrance and environmental traces
